title: Composition VS Inheritance
hint: Think: is a movie a fundamentally different type of video, or just a video with extra features?
b1t: Inheritance, because movies extend videos with additional behavior.
b2t: Inheritance, because movies should be a seperate thing than normal videos.
b3t: Composition, because a movie is just a video with extra features, not a completely different type.
b4t: Composition, because we don't ever use inheritance when we can use composition.
